meta.title: Meet Keith Kershaw, IPET dog groomer | Keith's K9 Care
meta.description: Meet Keith Kershaw, IPET-qualified dog groomer (Mrs B's Academy, Leeds). Home salon in Hall Green, Wakefield WF4. One dog at a time in a quiet home.

hero.heading: Meet Keith.
hero.body: IPET-qualified dog groomer, former solicitor, and the only person your dog will see during a groom at Keith's K9 Care. It's one dog at a time in a quiet room, with my full attention.
hero.photoAlt: Keith Kershaw, IPET-qualified dog groomer at Keith's K9 Care, Hall Green

story.heading: I swapped the law for the grooming table.
paragraphs: I set up Keith's K9 Care, a professional dog grooming service in Wakefield, after more than 30 years working as a solicitor. I decided to swap the courtroom for the dog spa and work with dogs full-time.

My love of dogs began when our golden retriever, Ringo, arrived during lockdown. What started as a new addition to the family quickly grew into something much bigger, and before long Ringo was joined by Rolo, whose lively, playful streak is the perfect contrast to Ringo's calm and gentle nature.

As any retriever owner will know, they have a real talent for finding mud, muck and anything they shouldn't be in. Between long walks, muddy fields and their love of the outdoors, Ringo and Rolo keep me on my toes and forever cleaning and grooming. It's given me plenty of hands-on experience and a real appreciation for how much regular, thorough grooming and coat care matters.
Wanting a complete change of direction, I trained professionally at Mrs B's in Leeds and built up the skills to offer dog grooming to a high standard.

These days I run a calm, one-to-one dog grooming service in Wakefield from my purpose-built home spa. Every dog I care for has my full attention, with no other animals around during their appointment. It makes for a relaxed, safe and stress-free room, which suits nervous or anxious dogs especially well.

whyKeith.heading: What sets Keith's K9 Care apart.
whyKeith.description: It comes down to six things, most of which other groomers can't or won't match.

pillars.heading: IPET qualified
pillars.body: Trained with the iPET Network at Mrs B's Grooming Academy in Leeds. That's a regulated UK awarding body rather than a quick weekend course.

pillars.heading: Fully insured
pillars.body: Public liability and care, custody & control cover for every dog in the salon. Certificates available on request.

pillars.heading: One dog at a time
pillars.body: There are no kennels or shared dryers, and your dog won't hear others barking through the wall. They have Keith's full attention from start to finish.

pillars.heading: Published, transparent
pillars.body: Small dogs from £40, medium from £50, large/doodles from £60. Surcharges listed. Keith confirms in person before he starts.

pillars.heading: Welfare first
pillars.body: If a heavily matted coat can't be saved kindly, I'll tell you straight. And if your dog gets too anxious, I stop and give you a call every time.

pillars.heading: WF4 home patch
pillars.body: On Castle Meadows in Hall Green, a short stroll from Newmillerdam Country Park. Most customers are within a 5-minute drive.

training.heading: IPET Network qualified
training.body: Keith completed his iPET Network qualification at Mrs B's Grooming Academy in Leeds, one of West Yorkshire's most respected practical training schools. The iPET Network is an Ofqual-regulated awarding body for the UK pet industry, so the certificates can be checked and verified properly.

insurance.heading: Fully insured
insurance.body: Public liability and care, custody & control cover for every dog in the salon. Happy to share certificate details on request before your first booking.

salon.heading: A home, not a clinic.
salon.description: The salon is a fully equipped, purpose-built converted garage at our home in Hall Green, on a quiet street between Newmillerdam and Chapelthorpe. There are no barking neighbours and no queue. Your dog gets the whole room to themselves.

philosophy.heading: A calm pace and clear pricing.

cards.b: There's no kennel and no shared dryer noise, and your dog won't hear others barking through the wall. They have Keith's full attention from arrival to handover.
If a coat is heavily matted, sometimes the kindest thing is a fresh start. Keith will talk you through it before he picks up the clippers.
Nervous dogs and first-time puppies get breaks, treats and as much sniff-around time as they need. The bill reflects the real time taken, and Keith always confirms it with you first.

contactCta.heading: Like the sound of how Keith works?
contactCta.body: Drop him a message. He prefers a quick chat about your dog before you book the first appointment.
